narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think old patterns in the sky do not help new machines at all.
<bookmark mark='link'/>But the rules found from the Moon and planets are used to place satellites today.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>An old pattern can become a rule that helps people for hundreds of years.
